Omar Rekkache représente l'Algérie au Fo: Omar Rekkache represents Algeria at the 2026 World Investment Forum in Doha
Le directeur général de l'Agence algérie: The Director General of the Algerian Investment Promotion Agency (AAPI), Omar Rekkache, will take part in the 9th edition of the World Investment Forum 2026, to be held in Doha from October 25 to 27.
Organisé par la CNUCED en partenariat av: Organized by UNCTAD in partnership with the State of Qatar, the forum provides a high-level international platform dedicated to investment and development issues. It brings together government officials, investors, business leaders, and representatives from the private sector and international organizations, fostering multidirectional exchanges.
L'événement permettra aux participants d: The event will enable participants to discuss key challenges related to international investment and to debate policies and strategies capable of mobilizing investments toward achieving sustainable development and strengthening economic growth, in a context marked by profound economic shifts. Discussions will notably address capital attraction mechanisms and suitable regulatory frameworks.
La participation de l'AAPI permettra à l: AAPI's participation will allow the Agency to contribute to the debates, share its expertise and experiences, and strengthen Algeria's presence by highlighting its investment attractiveness as well as the opportunities it offers to participating companies. This increased visibility is expected to stimulate foreign investment projects in Algeria.
Cette participation permettra également: This participation will also allow the Agency to consolidate its relations with its counterparts and explore new prospects for cooperation and partnership with the international institutions present. Collaborative agreements could be concluded to facilitate investment flows between Algeria and the represented countries.
Le thème « Investir dans l'avenir » guid: The theme "Investing in the Future" will guide discussions on investment strategies adapted to current and future economic challenges, with a focus on innovation, the energy transition, and social inclusion.
